latest_rss.title: Summer in Chongli: Coffee, hikes, and mountain views
latest_rss.summary: There's more to Chongli than just skiing!  Located about 150 kilometers north of Beijing, Chongli in Hebei Province rose to fame during the 2022 Winter Olympics. CGTN host Julian Waghann visits Fulong Four-Season Town to soak up its summer vibe. He orders the viral bell pepper coffee – where the rich aroma of coffee meets the sweet tang of bell pepper on your palate. Then he ascends to the summit at 2,160 meters, taking in the sweeping views of rolling mountains and alpine meadows. A ride on the giant swing gives him mountain breezes and lush greenery in every direction. The other side of this Olympic town has revealed itself – in every sip of coffee, every step into the wild, and every swing through the summer air.
